## Checklist

- [ ] For anything beyond a small fix, an issue was opened first describing the change (see the
      root [README.md's Contributing section](../README.md#contributing))
- [ ] `./mvnw test` passes locally for every module touched (Docker running, if `cerbos`/`example`
      Cerbos-backed tests are affected)
- [ ] Tests added/updated for the behavior change
- [ ] [README.md's Changelog section](../README.md#changelog) updated under `[Unreleased]`, if
      this is a user-facing change
- [ ] Relevant javadoc/README/`docs/DEEP_DIVE.md` section updated, if this changes documented
      behavior
